author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: यस्मादुक्तमहामहिमा तस्मात्कायं भूमौ प्रणिधाय ईशमीड्यं स्तुत्यं त्वा त्वां प्रणम्य प्रसादये । हे देव पित्रादिः पुत्रादेरिवापराधं सोढुमर्हसि ॥ ११.४४॥
translation: Therefore, I bow to Thee laying my body prostrate; I pray to Thee, the Ruler, the praiseworthy, for Thy favour; may Thou be pleased to bear with me as father with the son, friend with friend, and lover with the beloved. (44)
